items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: there were several bands going for that International Festival in Nice and Earl Hines and Jack Teagarden and Sid Catlett and Barney Bigard and Arvell Shaw and Velma Middleton

ctx.x: He was going to school. Art originally...was going around playing in...well, ...Art, during the early years, was a student. And he was quite unusual, and he used to go around various sections of the country and play in piano appearances with colleges, you know, and competitions. So that's as nearly as I can recall to my first meeting with him was that he was in that category. Now there's a professional performer. So that's ......... first knew him.
